model.title: A resolution designating June 15, 2026, as "World Elder Abuse Awareness Day" and the month of June 2026 as "Elder Abuse Awareness Month".

summary.text: The resolution would designate a specific day in June 2026 as "World Elder Abuse Awareness Day" and the entire month of June 2026 as "Elder Abuse Awareness Month" to draw attention to the problem of elder abuse.
